matched_boot_profiles.qualification_scope: reference boot ISA subset; additional optional RTL extensions are not qualified by this profile
matched_boot_profiles.source_changes: Only the pre-existing pinned non-PIE and CLINT/platform recipes were applied. fw_base.S, sbi_init.c, sbi_hsm.c, platform/generic/platform.c and libfdt/fdt_ro.c retain their exact upstream hashes.

strict_dual_reference.status: reference input, not yet configuration-aligned for hyp8
strict_dual_reference.mismatch: DTB advertises zicbom and zacas; hyp8 disables both

linux_reference.status: reference input, source/profile identity and DTB adaptation required before qualification
linux_reference.mismatch: DTB advertises H, zicbom and zacas; hyp8 disables all three

excluded.hyp8_smoke.S: duplicate forward numeric label sends zero-terminator branch into UART polling rather than completion
excluded.h3_load_replay.S: 4096-byte loop bound does not establish the documented 32-KiB cache-miss envelope

concurrency.decision: explicit overlap opt-in for isolated work within measured spare capacity; no shared source mutation or workload termination
concurrency.performance_claim: none; host wall-clock timing under overlap is not a comparative performance measurement
